description: Frontend core infrastructure: Tailwind theme, shared types, Axios client with interceptors, AuthContext with JWT refresh, React Router with all routes and role guards, AppShell layout, and a complete shared UI component library. Depends on FEAT-001 (package scaffolding) and FEAT-002 (backend running for login to work). This FEAT produces no user-facing pages beyond Login — all pages are built in FEAT-004 through FEAT-007.
steps: Configure campus-x/frontend/tailwind.config.ts: extend colors with primary (deep blue: 50-900 scale using #EFF6FF through #1E3A5F), accent (teal: 50-900 using #F0FDFA through #134E4A), danger (#EF4444 variants), warning (#F59E0B variants), success (#10B981 variants). Set darkMode: 'class'. Content: ['./index.html','./src/**/*.{ts,tsx}'].

Create campus-x/frontend/src/types/index.ts with ALL TypeScript interfaces matching backend Prisma output: User, Building, Floor, Room, Department, Subject, Semester, Class, TimetableEntry, RoomReservation, Resource, Complaint, ComplaintUpdate, EnergyRecord. Also API types: ApiResponse<T>, PaginatedResponse<T>, LoginRequest, LoginResponse, AvailabilityQuery, ComplaintCreateRequest, ResourceUploadRequest. Use exact field names from Prisma schema (camelCase).

Create campus-x/frontend/src/api/client.ts: Axios instance with baseURL from import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL (default http://localhost:3001/api). Request interceptor: attach Authorization: Bearer <token> from localStorage. Response interceptor: on 401, attempt token refresh via POST /auth/refresh — if refresh succeeds update stored token and retry original request; if refresh fails clear tokens and redirect to /login.

Create campus-x/frontend/src/api/endpoints.ts: typed API functions wrapping client.ts for every backend route: auth (login, register, me, logout), buildings (list, getById, create, update, uploadBlueprint, listFloors, createFloor), rooms (list, getById, create, update, patchStatus), departments (list, getById), timetable (getEntries, createEntry, importCSV, getConflicts, getClasses, getSemesters, getSubjects), availability (getRooms, getNow, isClassFree), reservations (create, list, getMyReservations, cancel), resources (upload, search, download, approve, delete, getMyUploads), complaints (file, list, getById, assign, updateStatus, getStats), ai (query), analytics (overview, utilization, complaints, alerts), optimization (suggest, apply), simulation (run), energy (getData, getAnomalies, getSummary), reports (get), ml (demandForecast, energyForecast, maintenanceForecast).

Create campus-x/frontend/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx: React context with state {user:User|null, isLoading:bool, isAuthenticated:bool}. Provide: login(email,password)→Promise, logout()→void, refreshUser()→Promise. On mount, if token in localStorage call GET /api/auth/me to hydrate user; set isLoading=false after. Export useAuth() hook. Export AuthProvider component.

Create campus-x/frontend/src/components/ui/ — complete component library: Button.tsx (variants: primary/secondary/ghost/danger, sizes: sm/md/lg, loading spinner state), Card.tsx (with CardHeader, CardBody, CardFooter sub-components), Modal.tsx (portal-based, backdrop click closes, ESC key closes, accessible aria-modal), Toast.tsx + useToast.ts (toast queue context, auto-dismiss 4s, variants success/error/warning/info), Badge.tsx (colored pill, variants for RoomStatus and ComplaintStatus), Skeleton.tsx (animated pulse placeholders for card/row/avatar), Input.tsx (label, error message, helper text, register prop for react-hook-form), Select.tsx (same pattern as Input), Textarea.tsx, FileInput.tsx (drag-drop zone + click, shows file name + size), EmptyState.tsx (icon + title + description + optional action button), ErrorBoundary.tsx (class component, catches render errors, shows fallback UI with retry button), Spinner.tsx (animated ring, sizes sm/md/lg), Table.tsx (responsive, sortable headers, loading state), Pagination.tsx.

Create campus-x/frontend/src/components/layout/Sidebar.tsx: collapsible sidebar (width 240px expanded, 60px collapsed, toggle button). Navigation items grouped by role: ADMIN sees all sections, FACULTY sees faculty sections, STUDENT sees student sections, GUEST sees only public sections. Each nav item has icon (Lucide), label, href. Highlight active route. Collapse to icon-only on mobile.
Create campus-x/frontend/src/components/layout/TopBar.tsx: top bar with: app logo/title CAMPUS-X, breadcrumb trail, user avatar + name + role badge, notification bell (placeholder), logout button.

Create campus-x/frontend/src/components/layout/AppShell.tsx: combines Sidebar + TopBar + main content area. Wraps all authenticated pages. Sidebar toggle state managed here with localStorage persistence.

Create campus-x/frontend/src/router/index.tsx: React Router v6 with createBrowserRouter. Routes: / → redirect to /dashboard if authenticated else /login. /login → LoginPage (lazy). Role-guarded layout routes: /dashboard (all roles), /campus-map (all roles including guest), /find-classroom (all roles), /timetable (faculty+student+admin), /ai-copilot (all authenticated), /resources (student+faculty+admin), /complaints (all authenticated), /admin/* (admin only: /admin/buildings, /admin/rooms, /admin/timetable, /admin/complaints, /admin/analytics, /admin/optimization, /admin/simulation, /admin/energy, /admin/reports, /admin/ml), /faculty/* (faculty+admin: /faculty/upload, /faculty/reservations), /student/* (student+admin: /student/resources). Create RoleGuard component that reads useAuth() and redirects to /unauthorized if role not allowed. Create /unauthorized and /404 pages.

Create campus-x/frontend/src/pages/auth/LoginPage.tsx: centered card with CAMPUS-X logo, email+password fields (react-hook-form + zod validation), login button with loading state, role-based redirect after login (admin→/admin/analytics, faculty→/timetable, student→/timetable, guest→/campus-map). Show demo credentials in a collapsible info box.
Create campus-x/frontend/src/pages/NotFoundPage.tsx and campus-x/frontend/src/pages/UnauthorizedPage.tsx: styled pages with navigation links back to appropriate dashboard.

Create campus-x/frontend/src/main.tsx: wrap App in AuthProvider, QueryClientProvider (TanStack Query with retry:1, staleTime:30s), BrowserRouter. Create campus-x/frontend/src/App.tsx: render RouterProvider.
Run `cd campus-x/frontend && npm run build` — must exit 0 with no TypeScript errors.
acceptance_criteria: `cd campus-x/frontend && npm run build` exits 0 with no TypeScript errors or Tailwind errors
`cd campus-x/frontend && npm run dev` starts on port 5173
Navigating to http://localhost:5173 shows the LoginPage with CAMPUS-X branding and demo credentials box
Logging in with admin@campusx.edu / Admin@123 redirects to /admin/analytics (even if that page shows empty state)
Logging in with guest@campusx.edu / Guest@123 redirects to /campus-map
Navigating to /admin/buildings while logged in as student redirects to /unauthorized
AppShell renders with collapsible sidebar and top bar for authenticated routes
All UI components render without console errors (Toast, Modal, Skeleton, EmptyState, ErrorBoundary exercised via Storybook-style manual check OR confirmed by build passing)
